name: Kuga Mikoto
source:
A beautiful and mature young lady. Born into a wealthy family, she is responsible and dependable, but sometimes her nature can come across as bossy. She’s never talked to any males other than her childhood friend, so she is a bit uneasy living on the airship.

She has the ability to create magical barriers. She was able to protect the temple as well as those important to her before the airship came. She was taught that her powers were bestowed by god, and is very proud of it.

The routes of Itsuki, Sakuya, and Natsuhiko are only accessible when the player selects Mikoto as the protagonist.

[From [url=http://aksysgames.com/norn9/characters/]English official site[/url]]
